constraints.name: AvailabilityInterval_configurationId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("configurationId") REFERENCES "ServiceConfiguration"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: AvailabilityInterval_protocol_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (("httpState" IS NULL OR ("httpState" = ANY (ARRAY['up'::text, 'down'::text]))) AND ("httpsState" IS NULL OR ("httpsState" = ANY (ARRAY['up'::text, 'down'::text]))))

constraints.name: AvailabilityInterval_serviceId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("serviceId") REFERENCES "Service"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: Dashboard_monitoring_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ("checkIntervalSeconds" > 0 AND "screenshotIntervalSeconds" > 0 AND "monitoringRevision" > 0 AND ("hourlyRetentionDays" IS NULL OR "hourlyRetentionDays" > 0) AND ("dailyRetentionDays" IS NULL OR "dailyRetentionDays" > 0) AND ("availabilityRetentionDays" IS NULL OR "availabilityRetentionDays" > 0))
